tool.name: create_charge
tool.description: To charge a credit card or other payment source, you create a Charge object.

amount.description: Amount intended to be collected by this payment. A positive integer representing how much to charge in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00).

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase. Must be a supported currency.

source.description: A payment source to be charged. This can be the ID of a card, a bank account, or a source.

description.description: An arbitrary string which you can attach to a Charge object.

query: Charge 50 USD to the card src_18eYalAHEMiOZZp1l972T.
